title: Renew a Kenyan passport
summary: Apply and pay on eCitizen, then give your fingerprints and photo at a passport centre (or a Kenyan embassy if you live abroad).

sources.title: Directorate of Immigration Services: Passport section
Kenya High Commission Ottawa: e-passport information
The Kenya Times: 50-page booklet option disabled (Feb 2026)

cost.note: Depends on the booklet the eCitizen form offers you. Embassy pages list KES 4,550 to 7,550, but in 2026 many applicants were only offered the 66-page booklet at about KES 12,500. Pay the amount on your eCitizen invoice.

processing_time: Several weeks. Some embassies abroad quote 4 to 6 weeks.
documents_needed: Your current passport (even if expired), plus a copy of the photo page
Original national ID and a copy (18 and over)
Passport photos that meet the immigration rules
The application form and payment receipts printed from eCitizen

steps.title: Log in to eCitizen
steps.detail: Open eCitizen and choose the Directorate of Immigration Services.

steps.title: Start a passport application
steps.detail: Choose the passport type and select renewal or replacement as the reason. Fill in the form.

steps.title: Pay the fee
steps.detail: Pay the amount shown on your invoice. Keep both receipts.

steps.title: Book a biometrics appointment
steps.detail: Pick a passport processing centre, or your nearest Kenyan embassy if you live abroad.

steps.title: Go to your appointment
steps.detail: Bring the documents listed above. Your fingerprints and photo are taken there.

steps.title: Track and collect
steps.detail: Track the status on eCitizen and collect the passport when it's ready. Then snap it into Upkept.

tips: Kenyan embassies advise applying at least six months before your passport expires.
Many countries refuse entry if your passport has less than 6 months left, so check your next trip first.
Only apply through eCitizen. Paper applications are not accepted.
